lines.t: Come, all those who have been abandoned
I will comfort you and give you shelter
Come all who are crippled
Let us run and leap for joy together
Come all those faithless
I shall fill your cup and watch how it overflows
Drink from this cup
Which I have poured out for you
Embrace this word
Which I have spoken to you
Return to me in sincerity and in truth
That I may gather you
That I may shelter you
Under the shadow of my healing wing
The way is open
Approach and draw near to me
Hear me calling
You are my treasure
The apple of my eye
Long awaited
Hear the voice of your redeemer
And accept my warm embrace
Open your eyes also
So you may see and behold my image
For I was marred more than any man
The blood of the Holy Sacrifice
Covered me
Yet I am risen up in glory
Clothed in grace
And seated forever at the right hand of the Father
Embrace me now
For my love casts out fear
No more shall you tear your life behind
For I shall see to it
For I see of myself in them
And they shall by no means be taken through
They shall be held fast in my arms
In the house of the Lord
My love is great
And I must see with that none
No, not one shall be left behind
Of those who are counted worthy to escape
Let go, give up, I am enough
Yield my son
Give up everything
Stop holding on so tightly to that which must pass away
I was destroyed
Destroyed, because of my love for you
I gave up everything, because of my love for you
Love, the power of my love
Partake of my fullness
For I've entered in
It is time
Beloved
It is time
Know me, here I am
Oh, beloved
How I love you
You shall love me
As I have loved you
Yes, you shall love me
With all abandonment
Love me
For I love you
Trust with abandonment, obey without expectation
Love without condition, for in this shall you truly know me
With your faith progressing quickly toward perfection
Hurry, seek out the thirsty and fill their cups
Feed the hungry and the poor in spirit
And those who resist, pray for them
And be my example
They will drink later
Beloved, I love you as you are
Now serve me
Cause I have loved you
Stand up and walk with me
Relying on my strength in your weakness
By which my strength
And your trust is made perfect
You shall be my joy
Or as the Son is one with the Father and the Father with the Son
So shall you be one in Him and Him in you forever
Let the redeemed of the Lord come running for their time
Time has come
